title: PhD in Militarization of Societal Resilience at Wageningen, Netherlands

organization.name: Wageningen University & Research
organization.about: Wageningen University & Research is a Dutch institution focused on life sciences, agriculture, food and the environment. It combines university education with research addressing sustainable food systems and living environments. Its programmes and projects connect biological, environmental and social perspectives, supporting collaboration with academic institutions, industry and public organisations worldwide.

description:
Project Overview

This Wageningen doctorate examines the militarization of societal resilience: how preparations for crisis and war reshape relationships between civilian institutions, communities and military actors.

Research Position Overview

Combine critical military and resilience studies with qualitative empirical research and policy analysis. The project is hosted by Sociology of Development and Change and considers the political and social consequences of changing civil–military arrangements.

Research Areas

  • Militarization
  • Societal resilience
  • Qualitative research

Funding and Duration

Employment and financial support

LanguageFluent Dutch and C1-level English are required.

Important Notes

  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

  • CV: maximum two pages.
  • Motivation letter: maximum one page; submit only the requested three-page application at this stage.

Submit through the application system linked from the official vacancy. Follow its current document and translation instructions.

Selection and Contact

Interviews are planned for 10 December 2026. A certificate of conduct (VOG) is required following selection.

Research contact: Jori Kalkman; supervisory team includes Bram Büscher and Sumit Vij.

About Wageningen University & Research

Wageningen University & Research works across food, agriculture, environment and society. The vacancy identifies the specific chair group and supervisory team responsible for this project.
